notes.title: Our Next Fest demo is out!
notes.content:
Greetings! Although Next Fest kicks into gear officially next Monday, we wanted to start the festivities early. We have just released a massively upgraded demo, which includes a whole lot of new stuff. Your feedback has been extremely valuable, and we’ve taken that to heart while revising the game.

In this update, you’ll find:

[list]
[*] Triple the content! You should definitely start a new game more than once. There are loads of new content for you to consume

[*] Completely revised inventory system. You use items to hotspots by selecting them from the inventory while you’re on top of a hotspot instead of them being used automatically if you happened to carry them

[*] Saving! You can actually save your progress. What madness!

[*] New fonts for better readability

[*] Polished UI & graphics
[/list]

Have fun playing!

Oh, and if you haven't seen our amazing trailer, here's that too

[previewyoutube=GH0XAOE8fSg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: We're DONE with content!
notes.content:
Cheers! This week we achieved a very important milestone as all the levels of the game are now in place. This means that the game can be now completed from start to finish, which is pretty damn crazy! It's been pretty intense couple of months, so I'm very, very happy (and also relieved) that we're finally at this stage!

More on the weekly devlog below.

notes.title: First we develop, then we polish. Check out this week's devlog
notes.content:
Cheers everyone!

One of my subscribers asked last week why does Hyperdrive Inn look like it's a work in progress. Well, that's because it is. We're launching the game in October, so we're still neck deep in the development work, and we're not focusing our efforts on polish before we're done with the core of the game. This is a good question and deserves an answer, so in this week's devlog we're talking about finishing touches, or rather the lack of them.
